subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should pre-existing controller-wide active descendants suppress the diagnostic, or must continuation evidence be fresh or explicitly bound to waking this yielded parent?
rationale: Code inspection can identify available signals, but it cannot decide whether an older or unrelated descendant satisfies the product promise behind sessions_yield; that choice determines whether the canonical silent-park incident is fully fixed.

options.title: Require bound wake evidence
options.body: Suppress the diagnostic only for continuation work established by this turn or explicitly registered to wake this yielded parent.

options.title: Accept any active descendant
options.body: Keep the current controller-wide rule and treat any active descendant as sufficient even when it predates the yielded turn.

options.title: Move validation into the tool
options.body: Pause this patch and define a stricter sessions_yield acceptance contract before emitting terminal metadata.

recommendation.title: Require bound wake evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress the diagnostic only for continuation work established by this turn or explicitly registered to wake this yielded parent.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged work defining yielded-parent lifecycle semantics makes this the strongest available owner for the continuation-boundary decision.
